en: A copy of the will left by their mother — in the late stages of dementia — gives 60 percent to the younger son, Yoon Jung-hoo, and 40 percent to the elder, Yoon Tae-seong. Yoon Tae-seong, who lived with their mother and cared for her, has filed for trial, refusing to accept the ratio.
ja: 認知症末期の母が遺した遺言書の写しには、次男ユン・ジョンフ60パーセント、長男ユン・テソン40パーセントと記されている。母を介護してきたユン・テソンはこの比率を受け入れられないとして、裁判を申し立てた。

notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 60대 40 유서 사본, 요양원 방문기록, 전 요양보호사 음성증언까지 공개됐다. 윤정후는 어머니를 자주 찾은 사실은 인정하지만, 말년의 판단을 흔들었다는 의혹은 부인한다. 이제 심문을 통해 어머니가 정말 스스로 판단할 수 있었는지 확인해야 한다.
en: The 60:40 will copy, the care-home visit log, and the former care worker's voice testimony have all been disclosed. Yoon Jung-hoo admits to visiting often but denies any suggestion that he influenced their mother's final judgement. Whether their mother was truly able to decide on her own must now be confirmed through interrogation.
ja: 60対40の遺言書写し、療養院の面会記録、元介護士の音声証言までが公開された。ユン・ジョンフは母を頻繁に訪ねた事実は認めるが、晩年の判断を揺さぶったという疑いは否認している。これからは尋問を通じて、母が本当に自ら判断できる状態だったのかを確かめなければならない。
zh-CN: 六比四的遗嘱副本、疗养院探访记录、前任护理员的录音证言——都已公开。尹正厚承认频繁前往母亲身边的事实，但否认动摇过其晚年判断的指控。如今须通过讯问，确认母亲是否真能独自作出判断。

ko: 양측 모두 진정하십시오. 순서대로 듣겠습니다.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 윤태성 씨, 그렇게 의심하게 된 근거를 더 말씀하십시오.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 태도 평가는 접고, 확인된 사실부터 보겠습니다.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 윤정후 씨, 지금처럼 짧게 답하면 의심만 커집니다. 분명하게 말씀하십시오.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 윤정후 씨, 바로 답하기 어렵다면 천천히 정리해서 말씀하십시오.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 지금은 단정하지 말고, 이 부분은 심문에서 확인하겠습니다.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 우선 공개된 증거부터 차례로 보겠습니다.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 비율보다 먼저, 말년의 어머니 상태를 각자 어떻게 봤는지 듣겠습니다.
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 윤정후가 어머니에게 종이를 읽어드리고 형이 오기 전 마치려 한 정황을 분리해 본다.
en: Separate the situation in which Yoon Jung-hoo read the paper aloud to their mother and tried to wrap up before his elder brother arrived.
ja: ユン・ジョンフが母に紙を読み上げ、兄が来る前に終わらせようとした状況を切り分けて見る。
zh-CN: 尹正厚在母亲面前反复念那张纸、并在哥哥到达之前赶着收尾的情形——把它单独抽出来看。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 종이를 읽어드린 장면
en: The Scene of the Paper Being Read Aloud
ja: 紙を読み上げた場面
zh-CN: 在母亲面前念纸的场景
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 동기가 무엇이든 어머니 문서에 손댄 책임을 확인한다.
en: Whatever the motive, confirm the responsibility for any handling of the mother's document.
ja: 動機が何であれ、母の文書に手を加えた責任を確かめる。
zh-CN: 无论动机为何——对母亲的文件动过手的责任，要单独确认。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 위조 책임
en: Responsibility for Tampering
ja: 改ざんの責任
zh-CN: 对文件动手的责任
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 돈을 말하지 않은 침묵이 보호였는지 기만이었는지 확인한다.
en: Examine whether keeping silent about the money was protection or deception.
ja: 金銭について語らなかった沈黙が保護だったのか欺瞞だったのかを確かめる。
zh-CN: 对钱不言不语——这是出于保护，还是出于隐瞒？分清楚。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 형의 체면과 침묵
en: The Elder Brother's Pride and Silence
ja: 兄の体面と沈黙
zh-CN: 面子下的沉默
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 민감한 가족 사정이 유서 변경 판단과 어떻게 이어졌는지 묻는다.
en: Ask how the sensitive family circumstances connected to the decision to change the will.
ja: 繊細な家族の事情が、遺言書変更の判断とどのように結びついたのかを問う。
zh-CN: 敏感的家事如何延伸成对遗嘱改动的判断——逐项追问。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 유서 변경과 연결
en: Link to the Will Change
ja: 遺言書変更とのつながり
zh-CN: 敏感家事与遗嘱改动的连接
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 한쪽 악역 구도가 아니라 서로 다른 방식의 책임을 함께 정리한다.
en: Not a one-sided villain frame, but a record of the two different forms of responsibility, organised together.
ja: 片方だけを悪役にする構図ではなく、それぞれ異なる形の責任を併せて整理する。
zh-CN: 不是一边设为恶人——而是把双方各自不同方式的责任，并排整理出来。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 두 형제의 공동 책임
en: Joint Responsibility of the Two Brothers
ja: 兄弟の共同責任
zh-CN: 两兄弟的共同责任
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 조심스럽게
en: cautiously
ja: 慎重に
zh-CN: 谨慎地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 문서를 읽어주는 장면을 본 적 있습니까?
en: Did you ever see anyone reading documents to her?
ja: 書類を読み聞かせる場面を見たことはありますか。
zh-CN: 你见过有人给她读文件吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 네, 종이 읽어드리는 건 몇 번 봤습니다. 그 장면만 놓고 보면 저도 좀 신경 쓰이긴 했어요.
en: Yes, I saw him read papers to her several times. Looking only at that scene, it bothered me a little too.
ja: はい、紙を読んであげているのは何度か見ました。その場面だけを見ると、私も少し気になりました。
zh-CN: 见过。我看过几次他给她读纸上的内容。只看那个场面，我也觉得有些在意。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 문서를 읽어주는 장면을 묻는다
en: Ask about the scene of reading documents
ja: 書類を読み聞かせる場面を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问读文件的场面
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 담담하게
en: calmly
ja: 淡々と
zh-CN: 平静地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 둘째 아들이 찾아오면 어머니 반응이 어땠습니까?
en: How did the mother react when the younger son came to visit?
ja: 次男が訪ねて来ると、お母様の反応はどうでしたか。
zh-CN: 次子来看望时，母亲的反应如何？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그분 오시면 표정이 조금 풀리긴 했어요. 그래서 저는 처음엔 반가운 사람인가 보다 했습니다.
en: When he came, her expression did soften a little. At first I thought he must be someone she was glad to see.
ja: その方が来ると、表情が少し和らぎました。だから最初は、会えてうれしい人なのだと思いました。
zh-CN: 他来的时候，她的表情会稍微软下来。所以我一开始以为，他是她见了会高兴的人。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 둘째 아들 방문 때 반응을 묻는다
en: Ask about her reaction when the younger son visited
ja: 次男が訪れた時の反応を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问次子来访时的反应
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 신중하게 고르며
en: choosing words carefully
ja: 慎重に言葉を選ぶ
zh-CN: 谨慎措辞
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 종이를 읽어드리던 날, 윤정후 씨가 따로 한 말이 있었습니까?
en: On the day the paper was read to her, did Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo say anything separately?
ja: 紙を読んでいた日、ユン・ジョンフさんが別に言ったことはありましたか。
zh-CN: 读那张纸的当天，尹正厚先生有单独说过什么吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 있었습니다. 윤정후 씨가 “형님 오시기 전에 마무리하자”고 했어요. 다만 그 말은 욕심이라기보다, 그날 또 큰소리 날까 봐 조심하는 느낌에 가까웠습니다.
en: He did. Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo said, "Let us finish before my older brother comes." But it felt less like greed and more like caution because there might be another loud argument that day.
ja: ありました。ユン・ジョンフさんが「兄さんが来る前に終わらせよう」と言いました。ただ、その言葉は欲というより、その日また大声になるのを避けたいという慎重さに近く感じました。
zh-CN: 有。尹正厚先生说过：“哥哥来之前把这件事结束吧。”不过那句话听起来不像贪心，更像是担心那天又会大声争吵，所以很小心。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 마무리하자는 말의 맥락을 묻는다
en: Ask about the context of finishing things up
ja: 終わらせようという言葉の文脈を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问“先结束”的语境
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 사실만 정리하듯
en: stating only the facts
ja: 事実だけを整理するように
zh-CN: 只整理事实
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 반가워했다는 것과 판단이 가능했다는 건 다른 문제입니다. 상태는 어땠습니까?
en: Being pleased to see him and being able to judge are different issues. What was her condition like?
ja: 喜んだことと判断できたことは別問題です。状態はどうでしたか。
zh-CN: 她高兴见到他，和她是否有判断能力，是两回事。她的状态怎么样？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 맞습니다. 어떤 날은 제 질문에도 또박또박 답했고, 어떤 날은 손을 잡아도 멍하셨습니다. 늘 또렷했다고는 못 하겠어요.
en: That is correct. Some days she answered my questions clearly, and other days she stared blankly even when I held her hand. I cannot say she was always lucid.
ja: その通りです。私の質問にきちんと答える日もあれば、手を握ってもぼんやりしている日もありました。いつもはっきりしていたとは言えません。
zh-CN: 是的。有些日子她能清楚回答我的问题，有些日子我握住她的手，她也只是发呆。我不能说她一直都很清醒。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 상태가 일정했는지 묻는다
en: Ask whether her condition was consistent
ja: 状態が一定だったか尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问状态是否稳定
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 조심스럽지만 분명하게
en: careful but clear
ja: 慎重だがはっきりと
zh-CN: 谨慎但明确
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 증인 기준으로 답하십시오. 그 과정은 어머니를 몰아간 장면이었습니까, 다툼을 피하려는 장면이었습니까?
en: Answer from your own perspective. Was that process a scene of pressuring the mother, or a scene of trying to avoid conflict?
ja: 証人の基準で答えてください。その過程はお母様を追い込む場面でしたか、それとも争いを避けようとする場面でしたか。
zh-CN: 请按证人的判断回答。那个过程是在逼迫母亲，还是在试图避免争吵？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 제가 옆에서 본 바로는 다툼을 피하려는 쪽이었습니다. 형님이 오시면 실제로 말소리가 커졌고, 그때마다 어머님이 어깨를 움츠리셨어요. 그래서 저는 둘째 아들이 어머니를 이용했다기보다, 겁먹지 않게 끝내려 한 걸로 봤습니다.
en: From what I saw beside them, it was closer to avoiding conflict. When the older brother came, voices really did get louder, and each time the mother hunched her shoulders. So I saw the younger son as trying to finish it without frightening her, not as using her.
ja: そばで見た限りでは、争いを避けようとする側でした。兄さんが来ると実際に声が大きくなり、そのたびにお母様は肩をすくめていました。だから私は、次男がお母様を利用したというより、怖がらせずに終わらせようとしていたと見ました。
zh-CN: 以我在旁边看到的情况，更接近于避免争吵。哥哥来了之后，声音确实会变大，每次母亲都会缩起肩膀。所以我认为次子不是在利用母亲，而是在尽量不要让她害怕地把事情结束。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 과정의 실제 분위기를 묻는다
en: Ask about the real atmosphere of the process
ja: その過程の実際の雰囲気を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问过程中的真实气氛
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 차분하게
en: calmly
ja: 落ち着いて
zh-CN: 沉着地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 처음 가져온 서류와 다시 가져온 서류의 인상이 달랐습니까?
en: Did the first document and the resubmitted document feel different?
ja: 最初に持って来た書類と、再提出された書類の印象は違いましたか。
zh-CN: 第一次带来的文件和后来重新提交的文件，给人的印象不同吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 달랐습니다. 처음 것은 한쪽으로 많이 기운 느낌이었고, 다시 낸 것은 그보다 조금 균형 잡혀 보였어요.
en: They did. The first one felt heavily tilted to one side, and the resubmitted one looked a little more balanced.
ja: 違いました。最初のものは片方に大きく偏っている感じで、出し直されたものはそれより少し均衡が取れて見えました。
zh-CN: 不同。第一份感觉很偏向一方，重新提交的那份看起来比前一份更平衡一些。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 두 서류의 인상을 묻는다
en: Ask about the impression of the two documents
ja: 二つの書類の印象を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问两份文件的印象
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 업무적으로 정확하게
en: professionally precise
ja: 業務的に正確に
zh-CN: 职业且准确
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그날 같은 사람이 두 번 찾아온 일이 있었습니까?
en: Did the same person come to the office twice that day?
ja: その日、同じ人が二度訪ねて来たことはありましたか。
zh-CN: 那天同一个人来过两次吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 네, 같은 분이 같은 날 두 번 오셔서 기억합니다. 흔한 일은 아닙니다.
en: Yes, the same person came twice on the same day, so I remember it. That is not common.
ja: はい、同じ方が同じ日に二度来られたので覚えています。よくあることではありません。
zh-CN: 有。同一个人同一天来了两次，所以我记得。这并不常见。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 같은 날 두 번 온 사실을 묻는다
en: Ask whether the same person came twice that day
ja: 同じ日に二度来た事実を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问同一天来过两次的事实
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 분명하게
en: clearly
ja: はっきりと
zh-CN: 清楚地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 차이를 숫자로 설명하십시오. 어떻게 바뀌었습니까?
en: Explain the difference in numbers. How did it change?
ja: その違いを数字で説明してください。どう変わりましたか。
zh-CN: 请用数字说明差异。比例是怎么变的？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 첫 서류는 윤정후 90, 윤태성 10이었고, 두 번째는 윤정후 60, 윤태성 40으로 바뀌었습니다. 숫자만 보면 자기 몫을 줄여서 다시 낸 셈이었습니다.
en: The first document was Yoon Jeong-hoo 90 and Yoon Tae-seong 10. The second was changed to Yoon Jeong-hoo 60 and Yoon Tae-seong 40. Judging only by the numbers, he reduced his own share and submitted it again.
ja: 最初の書類はユン・ジョンフ90、ユン・テソン10で、二つ目はユン・ジョンフ60、ユン・テソン40に変わっていました。数字だけ見れば、自分の取り分を減らして出し直したことになります。
zh-CN: 第一份文件是尹正厚90、尹泰成10，第二份改成了尹正厚60、尹泰成40。只看数字的话，相当于是他减少了自己的份额后重新提交。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 비율이 어떻게 바뀌었는지 묻는다
en: Ask how the ratio changed
ja: 比率がどう変わったか尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问比例如何改变
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 기억이 선명하다는 듯
en: as if the memory is clear
ja: 記憶が鮮明なように
zh-CN: 像是记忆清楚
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 두 번 다 누가 접수창구에 섰습니까?
en: Who stood at the reception desk both times?
ja: 二回とも受付に立ったのは誰でしたか。
zh-CN: 两次都是谁站在受理窗口前？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 두 번 다 윤정후 씨가 접수창구에 서셨습니다. 서류를 도로 챙겨갔다가 다시 가져오신 것도 그분이었습니다.
en: Both times it was Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo. He was also the one who took the documents back and brought them again.
ja: 二回ともユン・ジョンフさんでした。書類をいったん持ち帰って、また持って来たのもその方です。
zh-CN: 两次都是尹正厚先生。把文件拿回去后又重新带来的也是他。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 누가 다시 제출했는지 묻는다
en: Ask who resubmitted the document
ja: 誰が再提出したか尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问是谁重新提交的
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 신중하지만 또렷하게
en: careful but distinct
ja: 慎重だが明瞭に
zh-CN: 谨慎但清晰
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 변경을 보고 증인께서는 누구 이익 쪽으로 움직인 수정이라고 판단했습니까?
en: When you saw that change, whose benefit did you think the revision moved toward?
ja: その変更を見て、証人は誰の利益に向かう修正だと判断しましたか。
zh-CN: 看到这个变更后，你认为这个修改是朝谁的利益方向移动？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 적어도 자기 몫을 늘리려는 수정은 아니었습니다. 접수창구에서 본 결과만 놓고 말하면, 윤정후 씨가 자기 비율을 90에서 60으로 낮춘 문서를 다시 낸 겁니다. 그래서 저는 그날의 수정이 탐욕 쪽이라기보다, 형이 받을 충격을 좀 줄여보려는 조정처럼 보였습니다.
en: At the very least, it was not a revision to increase his own share. Based only on what I saw at the desk, Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo brought back a document lowering his ratio from 90 to 60. So the revision looked less like greed and more like an adjustment to soften the shock for his brother.
ja: 少なくとも、自分の取り分を増やそうとする修正ではありませんでした。受付で見た結果だけで言えば、ユン・ジョンフさんは自分の比率を90から60に下げた書類を出し直したのです。だからその日の修正は、欲というより、兄が受ける衝撃を少し和らげる調整のように見えました。
zh-CN: 至少不是为了增加他自己的份额。从受理窗口看到的结果来说，尹正厚先生重新提交的是把自己的比例从90降到60的文件。所以我看来，那天的修改不像贪婪，更像是想稍微减轻哥哥受到的冲击。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 수정이 누구 이익 방향이었는지 묻는다
en: Ask whose benefit the revision served
ja: 修正が誰の利益に向いていたか尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问修改朝向谁的利益
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 차분히 떠올리며
en: recalling calmly
ja: 落ち着いて思い出しながら
zh-CN: 平静回忆
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 어머니가 정기적으로 들어오는 돈에 대해 하신 말이 있었습니까?
en: Did the mother ever say anything about money coming in regularly?
ja: お母様は定期的に入るお金について話したことがありますか。
zh-CN: 母亲有没有说过定期进账的钱？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 돈 걱정을 오래 하셨습니다. 그래도 작은아들이 달마다 보내주는 돈이 있어서 버틴다고 하신 적은 있어요.
en: She worried about money for a long time. Still, she once said she could endure because the younger son sent money every month.
ja: お金の心配を長くしていました。それでも、次男が毎月送ってくれるお金があるから持ちこたえられる、と話したことはあります。
zh-CN: 她长期担心钱的问题。不过她曾说过，因为小儿子每个月寄钱来，她才能撑下去。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 정기 지원금 사정을 묻는다
en: Ask about the regular support payments
ja: 定期支援金の事情を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问定期支援金情况
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 낮게 말하며
en: speaking quietly
ja: 低い声で
zh-CN: 低声说
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 어머니가 큰아들이 몰라야 한다고 한 일이 있었습니까?
en: Did the mother ever say there was something the older son must not know?
ja: お母様が、長男には知られてはいけないと言ったことはありましたか。
zh-CN: 母亲有没有说过，有些事大儿子不能知道？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 있었습니다. 어떤 일은 그 아들이 끝까지 몰라야 한다고 몇 번 말씀하셨어요. 말할 때마다 표정이 많이 무거웠습니다.
en: Yes. She said several times that one matter had to stay unknown to that son until the end. Whenever she said it, her expression became very heavy.
ja: ありました。あることはその息子が最後まで知らない方がいい、と何度かおっしゃいました。言うたびに表情がとても重くなりました。
zh-CN: 有。她说过好几次，有件事那个儿子直到最后都不能知道。每次说到这件事，她的表情都非常沉重。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 큰아들이 몰라야 한다는 말을 묻는다
en: Ask about saying the older son must not know
ja: 長男が知らない方がいいという言葉を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问“大儿子不能知道”的话
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 분명히 기억나는 부분만 짚으며
en: pointing only to what is clearly remembered
ja: はっきり覚えている部分だけを示す
zh-CN: 只指出清楚记得的部分
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 돈이 어떤 성격이라고 들었습니까? 누가 누구를 돕는 돈이었습니까?
en: What did you hear that money was for? Who was helping whom?
ja: そのお金はどのような性格だと聞きましたか。誰が誰を助けるお金でしたか。
zh-CN: 你听说那笔钱是什么性质？是谁在帮助谁？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 윤정후 씨가 어머니 통장으로 달마다 보내는 돈이라고 들었습니다. 그리고 3억원이 나갈 때는 “태성이 공장 쪽으로 보내는 돈”이라고 어머니가 직접 말씀하셨어요.
en: I heard it was money Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo sent every month to his mother’s account. And when the 300 million won went out, the mother herself said it was money being sent toward Tae-seong’s factory.
ja: ユン・ジョンフさんがお母様の口座に毎月送っているお金だと聞きました。そして3億ウォンが出る時は、「テソンの工場の方へ送るお金」だとお母様が直接おっしゃいました。
zh-CN: 我听说那是尹正厚先生每个月打到母亲账户里的钱。而3亿韩元转出时，母亲亲口说那是“要送到泰成工厂那边的钱”。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 돈의 성격을 묻는다
en: Ask what kind of money it was
ja: そのお金の性格を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问那笔钱的性质
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 조심스럽게
en: cautiously
ja: 慎重に
zh-CN: 小心地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 큰아들이 몰라야 한다고 한 이유를 들은 게 있습니까?
en: Did you hear why the older son must not know?
ja: 長男が知らない方がいいと言った理由を聞いたことはありますか。
zh-CN: 你听说过为什么大儿子不能知道吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 어머니가 정확한 말은 아끼셨지만, “태성이는 그 사실 알면 사람 무너진다”고 했어요. 그리고 “정후가 그 짐을 혼자 진다”는 말도 했습니다.
en: The mother avoided exact words, but she said, "If Tae-seong learns that fact, he will collapse as a person." She also said, "Jeong-hoo carries that burden alone."
ja: お母様は正確な言葉を避けましたが、「テソンはその事実を知ったら人として崩れてしまう」と言いました。それから「ジョンフがその重荷を一人で背負っている」とも言っていました。
zh-CN: 母亲没有把话说得很具体，但她说过：“泰成如果知道那个事实，人会垮掉。”她也说过：“正厚一个人背着那个负担。”
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 왜 숨겨야 한다고 했는지 묻는다
en: Ask why it had to be hidden
ja: なぜ隠す必要があったか尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问为什么必须隐瞒
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 무겁게, 그러나 흔들림 없이
en: heavy, but steady
ja: 重く、しかし揺らがずに
zh-CN: 沉重但坚定
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 증인이 들은 말을 종합하면, 윤정후 씨가 왜 그 비밀을 숨겼다고 보십니까?
en: Putting together what you heard, why do you think Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo kept that secret?
ja: 証人が聞いた話を総合すると、ユン・ジョンフさんはなぜその秘密を隠したと思いますか。
zh-CN: 综合你听到的话，你认为尹正厚先生为什么隐瞒那个秘密？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 유산 더 받으려고 숨긴 사람 말투가 아니었습니다. 어머니가 먼저 “태성이는 끝까지 몰라야 한다”고 붙잡았고, 윤정후 씨는 그 말대로 형이 무너지지 않게 막는 쪽이었어요. 그래서 저는 이 집안의 중심이 돈다툼보다 출생 비밀과 죄책감에 더 가까웠다고 봅니다.
en: It was not the tone of someone hiding something to get more inheritance. The mother first held on to him and said, "Tae-seong must never know," and Mr. Yoon Jeong-hoo was trying to keep his brother from falling apart as she asked. So I think the center of this family was closer to a birth secret and guilt than to a fight over money.
ja: 遺産を多く受け取るために隠した人の口ぶりではありませんでした。お母様が先に「テソンは最後まで知らない方がいい」と頼み、ユン・ジョンフさんはその通りに兄が崩れないようにしていました。だから私は、この家の中心は金銭争いよりも出生の秘密と罪悪感に近かったと思います。
zh-CN: 那不是为了多拿遗产而隐瞒的人会有的语气。是母亲先抓着他说“泰成到最后都不能知道”，尹正厚先生则按照她的话，想阻止哥哥崩溃。所以我认为这个家的核心，比起金钱争夺，更接近出生秘密和罪疚感。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 윤정후 씨가 왜 비밀을 숨겼는지 묻는다
en: Ask why Yoon Jeong-hoo kept the secret
ja: ユン・ジョンフがなぜ秘密を隠したか尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问尹正厚为何隐瞒秘密
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.
